highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 upgrades to Skia milestone m151 and delivers a focused performance sweep.
highlights_body: Multiple hot-path P/Invoke calls have been ported to managed integer math, allocation-free UTF-8 encoding and zero-copy span reads are used throughout the text pipeline, and WASM gains .NET 11 (Emscripten 5.0.6) support.

bullets.lead: Skia milestone m151 and upstream bug fixes
bullets.detail: The Skia engine was updated to milestone m151, followed by four rounds of upstream chrome/m151 stability and correctness fixes.

bullets.lead: SKColor hex parsing is faster and accepts ReadOnlySpan<char>
bullets.detail: The hex-color parser was rewritten in managed code and new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads were added, eliminating string allocations on hot parse paths.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed
bullets.detail: A native handle was leaked when calling SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) and the crop failed; the handle is now released correctly.

bullets.lead: Removed unnecessary unsafe modifier from GRContextOptions
bullets.detail: The unsafe modifier on GRContextOptions was removed — it was never needed and could confuse consumers enabling unsafe-code warnings.
New Emscripten 5.0.6 native assets ship in this release, enabling SkiaSharp to run on .NET 11 WASM previews with the new exnref exception-handling model.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: WASM .NET 11 Emscripten 5.0.6 support and various Uno/sample fixes.

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.151.0 line with the Skia m151 engine upgrade.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 delivered the performance sweep: allocation-free HarfBuzzSharp UTF-8 encoding, zero-copy shaper span reads, and per-call char[] allocation fixes in Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: RC 1 added WASM .NET 11 support (Emscripten 5.0.6), ported SKColor/SKPMColor math to managed code, and pulled in the final round of upstream m151 bug fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: Adds allocation-free UTF-8 encoding in HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8 and eliminates per-call char[] allocation in Tag.Parse, reducing GC pressure in high-frequency text layout loops.
